protocol.data_scope: reused PPO09 reference trajectories, not new-policy autonomous rollouts
protocol.absolute_residual: candidate next speed minus image next speed, at same target state
protocol.proxy_optimism: max(image next speed minus candidate next speed,0); threatens image-from-proxy inference
protocol.candidate_extra_speed: max(candidate next speed minus image next speed,0); replacement-path underbraking
protocol.main_aggregation: equal trajectory MAE plus tail metrics; frame MAE retained for comparison
protocol.worst_tail: mean of largest ceil(0.05*N) absolute errors; empirical, not a population risk bound
protocol.clipping: report action differences and pre-speed-clipping equivalents alongside true physical error
protocol.horizon_comparison: intersection of identical TARGET (trajectory,time), not identical context ends
protocol.frozen_barrier_metric: image B(next)-candidate B(next), divided by unsafe-lower minus domain-lower; no clamping or terminal overrides
protocol.barrier_test: noise-free pointwise diagnostic only, NOT original expected/interval decrease verification
